title: Shopify segment query functions use MATCHES instead of = true as of API version 2026-10
summary: As of Admin API version 2026-10, functions in the customer segment query language use MATCHES / NOT MATCHES instead of = true / = false (shopify_email.opened MATCHES ()), function parameters take their own operators, and the named dates 12_months_ago, 90_days_ago, 30_days_ago and 7_days_ago are deprecated.
migrationNote: Rewrite segment queries for 2026-10: replace function() = true with function MATCHES () and = false with NOT MATCHES (), move parameters inside the parentheses (products_purchased MATCHES (quantity = 5)), and replace named dates with offsets such as -12m.
